datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected Integrated Food Security Phase Classification (IPC) data on a monthly basis across Niger in 2011. The spatial classifications were compiled into geographic datasets representing different food insecurity scenarios and phases, indicating the severity and distribution of acute food insecurity across administrative units.
